adjudication.rationale: The finding identifies a real race condition in the new webhook endpoint. Looking at lines 57-77 in app-credential.ts, the code does a findFirst to check if a credential exists, then either updates or creates based on the result. If two concurrent requests for the same userId/appId both execute findFirst before either creates, both will get null and both will attempt to create, resulting in duplicate credentials. This is a classic TOCTOU (time-of-check-time-of-use) race condition. The code should use upsert or a unique constraint with proper error handling instead of this find-then-create pattern.
